config._note: All numeric behavioral, environmental, economic and sampling coefficients are fictional placeholders, not estimates. Map geometry only is reused. Days are zero based; weekday 0 is Monday. agent_scale is real residents per simulated agent; all counts and yen are placeholders. boost_saturation caps combined conversion boosts smoothly. PR coverage is one shared Bernoulli draw per seed. Costs are fictional yen per campaign, not scaled by population. Channels share conversion intent: strongest exposure wins (not summed), then smoothly saturates; combining channels mostly broadens reach.
